title: Apple Search Ads (ASA) Operations Manual
deck: ASA is the only keyword ad surfaced in App Store search results. With ~70% of iOS users discovering apps through App Store search, ASA is a must-run channel for iOS marketing.
summary: Run ASA as four separated campaign types (Search Match, Search Keywords, Discovery, Brand). Brand is a defensive campaign protecting your own name, Discovery mines new keywords, Search Keywords is manually optimized, Search Match is auto-matching — keeping them separate keeps each KPI clean.

content.html: Keywords that accumulate meaningful clicks in Discovery get promoted into the Generic campaign for direct bidding. Discovery is the mining channel; Generic is the operating channel.
Group keywords by intent at the ad-group level. Keywords in the same group share one CPI/CPA target.

rows: winter coat shopping, best puffer jackets

items: Cost-Per-Tap (CPT): ASA charges per tap. CPI = CPT / Tap-Through-Rate (TTR)
Max CPT bid: start at 1.2–1.5× Apple's suggested bid → adjust after ~7 days
CPA Goal: campaign-level option. Can auto-bid against Adjust-connected in-app events
Scheduling: ASA runs 24/7 by default. No per-hour off switch — only bid up/down adjustments

content.title: Brand campaign reports 0 installs
content.html: 1) Confirm the ASA Attribution API key is registered (Adjust → ASA Partner). 2) Verify the Brand keyword exactly matches your app name. 3) If your app ranks organic #1 for the search, Apple may auto-suppress the ad entirely.

content.title: Discovery burns budget with no installs
content.html: Search Match is matching overly broad keywords. Extract clicked keywords from the Adjust keyword report → add them as Negative Keywords. Block all category-irrelevant broad terms (e.g. just "game").

content.title: Using CPP (Custom Product Pages)
content.html: On iOS 15+, you can show different screenshots/copy per keyword. CPP variants attach at the ASA ad-group level. A variant matching the keyword improves TTR by 30–50% on average.
